rubric.name: correctness
rubric.description: Logic errors, unhandled edge cases, and broken invariants outrank all else.

rubric.name: regression-safety
rubric.description: This is a large, heavily-tested codebase run in production by its own agents. Weight hermetic tests, behavior preservation, and blast radius: a fix that unmasks or breaks distant tests, leaks live-environment state into tests, or changes shared plumbing without coverage is a finding even when the local change looks correct.

rubric.name: upstream-mergeability
rubric.description: This is a fork of gastownhall/gastown that may contribute patches upstream. Flag gratuitous divergence: unrelated reformatting, renames of upstream identifiers, fork-local conventions leaking into shared code, or changes that could be expressed as smaller upstream-friendly diffs.

rubric.name: tests
rubric.description: Changed behavior needs tests; regression fixes need a test that fails before the fix. Flag untested behavior changes.
